$comment: Per-agent model assignment. Read by scripts/models; semantics in docs/models.md. A consumer reads agents.<id>.tier, then profiles.<profile>.models.<tier>. The validator tier must differ from strong: a model approves its own errors 11.9 points more often when it wrote them, and that bias follows authorship, not the context window, so a fresh context on the same model is not an independent check. Where a profile cannot provide a second model it sets single_model_validation true, and the finding must say the validator pass was not independent.

mythos.reason: longest prompt, runs the whole engagement unattended and owns scope and closure decisions, so an error here costs the run

mythos-planner.reason: one structured plan from scope and surface, no long tool loop

mythos-recon.reason: drives httpx, katana and ffuf and summarises the surface; later phases check what it finds

mythos-scanner.reason: runs nuclei, dalfox and sqlmap and records candidates, which are unproven by definition

mythos-browser.reason: long Playwright tool loops, and its verdict on a client-rendered finding is evidence

mythos-exploiter.reason: decides validated versus unconfirmed under the exploit skill: exact request, negative control, validator pass

mythos-reporter.reason: turns validated findings into severity and CVSS and must not claim past the evidence

zai.needs: ZHIPU_API_KEY or `opencode auth login` (Z.AI Coding Plan)
zai.validator_note: This profile has no second model fit to re-check a proof, so the validator pass runs on the hunting model and is not independent. Set a cross-provider validator, or record the limitation in the finding.

zai-api.needs: ZHIPU_API_KEY or `opencode auth login` (Z.AI), pay per token
zai-api.validator_note: This profile has no second model fit to re-check a proof, so the validator pass runs on the hunting model and is not independent. Set a cross-provider validator, or record the limitation in the finding.

zen.needs: OPENCODE_API_KEY or `opencode auth login` (OpenCode Zen), pay per token, same GLM models hosted in the US and EU
zen.validator_note: The only second model here is Flash, which models.json already keeps out of the exploit phase, so it cannot be trusted to re-check a proof either. Validation is not independent on this profile.

claude_code.$comment: Aliases for the Claude Code `model:` frontmatter field. Not consumed yet: scripts/build-hosts.py still writes `model: inherit`.

validation.$comment: Which model re-checks a stored proof of concept.
validation.why: A fresh context does not remove self-preference: it is tied to authorship. Measured at 11.9 percentage points over 64,800 calls. Where validator equals strong, the pass is a re-run, not an independent check, and skills/exploit requires the finding to say so.
validation.cross_provider_example: OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT="$(scripts/models anthropic)" for the validator pass while the hunt runs on the default profile
